products.name: InternLM (Shanghai AI Lab)
products.note: Chinese open-source LLM; academic research; cross-border data review advised

reading.body:
Shanghai AI Laboratory is a government-affiliated research institution in China operating InternLM, an open-source large language model positioned for academic research across Chinese universities and scientific applications.

The laboratory's stated focus spans model capability, embodied robotics, and AI safety frameworks, with recent emphasis on science-oriented systems that integrate language models, specialist agents, and physical automation. This portfolio suggests a research strategy prioritizing broad capability development rather than any single domain constraint. The 2026 announcement of AI-for-science results and a scientific discovery platform indicates the institution is testing large models as infrastructure for experimental workflows, from hypothesis through validation.

What matters for AI infrastructure is that Shanghai AI Laboratory operates within China's university and research ecosystem, not as a commercial infrastructure builder or power provider. The laboratory contributes to model capability and research methodology but does not control the compute, buildings, or power grids that determine how quickly those capabilities can scale. It represents the downstream user of infrastructure, not the constraint that binds it.

The data does not cover the laboratory's budget, its access to compute hardware, or the power requirements of its training and inference systems. Without those facts, the connection between its research ambitions and the infrastructure constraints that may or may not enable them remains unmeasured.

profile_text.body:
Shanghai AI Laboratory is a non-profit government laboratory, according to its own site, which describes it as recruiting young talent in areas including AI, large models, embodied intelligence, trustworthy AI, AI for Science, and basic platforms. The site says that since 2022 the laboratory has run a joint doctoral training program with more than ten universities, among them Peking University, Tsinghua University, Fudan University, Shanghai Jiao Tong University, Tongji University, the University of Science and Technology of China, and Zhejiang University.

Its AI work centers on the InternLM family of open-source large language models, listed as a chat and general LLM product. The site also describes the Shusheng Duanyan scientific discovery platform, which it says was upgraded and fully opened at the 2026 Pujiang Innovation Forum, the Shusheng physical world model W0, the Intern-Robotics embodied intelligence engine, and the Shusheng scientific multimodal model S2. Professor Zhou Bowen is quoted on the idea that scientific research is the next programming, and the site describes a technical framework it calls the AI-45 degree balance law and a causal path toward trustworthy AGI.

The site reports ten joint scientific intelligence innovation results released with universities, research institutes, and industry partners at the 2026 WAIC science frontier forum, covering life sciences, materials science, and deep space astronomy. It also describes a "North Star" talent program. No litigation, MCP servers, or securities filings are recorded for the laboratory.
